fix: Change the field to `applied: Rc<std::cell::RefCell<ClipApplied>>,` (add `use std::rc::Rc;`). Every `applied: Default::default()` still compiles. `RenderLayers` is cloned on every kind change (tree/reconciliation.rs:666 and :678, `.layers.clone()`), and the derived Clone currently allocates a new Box and deep-copies ClipApplied (including its Option<RenderKind> and delegate) each time. With Rc the clone is a refcount bump that shares the same state. This is safe because the clone is written back over the original (reconciliation.rs:671) and only one copy stays live.

Move the cache check in `apply_clip` ahead of geometry construction. Compute `size_changed`, `delegate_kept` and `inputs_kept` first, return early when the cache holds, and only then call `clip_geometry(kind, size)`. The current order runs the user's CustomClipper (`clipper.clip(size)`) and, for ClipPath with a non-path clipper, `rect_path` (a new Path builder plus Arc allocation) on every layout and kind update, and then throws the result away when the cache hits. `apply_clip` runs from update_layout_geometry (tree/layout.rs:1104) for every laid-out clip node.

Replace the two statements with `compositor.set_children(root, picture.into_iter().chain(focus_picture).collect());` (the `_` arm of `RenderLayers::create`). This removes the intermediate `collect` and the extend. It runs only on mount and structure reconcile, not per frame.
